// note: Browser code. Tests are a separate project (tsconfig.test.json) because they read the ABI off disk and so need node types, which browser code must not have.
// noUncheckedIndexedAccess: Off for THIS project only, and only because of src/pages/landing.
That page is generated from the fleet-wide template by `pnpm landing:generate`,
and every other app that renders it has a hand-rolled tsconfig without this
flag — so the template has never been compiled under it and does not
index-check. Editing the generated copy is not an option: `pnpm landing:check`
fails CI the moment it drifts.
The test project (tsconfig.test.json) compiles the app code too, with the
same exception, since App.test.tsx renders the whole app.
